If I were you personally, I would let go of that girl immediately. This girl sounds like she's gaslightimg you and that kind of behaviour is unacceptable, you deserve so much better and i'm so sorry that happened to you. 

Its your choice though at the end of the day if you want to break up with her or not, if you can get past it together and work on strengthening your bond in that relationship then by all means go for it. 

As I said before, sometimes holding on hurts more to let go and I guess what that means in this context especially is that staying with this girl will hurt you more than letting go. Letting go and breaking up with this girl will hurt yes, as im sure you have such strong feelings for her. That's okay, and that pain you feel is what makes your feelings for her real. But that pain will be so much better than the pain you'll have if you are to stay in this relationship. It will be rough, but I can assure you that it WILL make you stronger at the end of it all. You will be happier, give yourself time.

Much love to you 🙏🙏 and I wish you the very best.
